note: One baked take in FBX/GLB (master timeline). Unity: split into clips by these frame ranges; loop=true clips are seamless.

clips.name: Idle
clips.desc: standby: charge rings counter-rotate 120 deg (3-fold symmetric, seamless loop)

clips.name: Charge
clips.desc: charge: rings spin up (counter-rotating) and close toward the core, antennas tilt out 18 deg, charge glow rises

clips.name: EMP
clips.desc: discharge: core flash 2 f, radial shock ring expands to 4.5x and vanishes, antennas kick, rings snap back

clips.name: Recovery
clips.desc: recovery: antennas fold back, rings coast to rest (480 deg = 120 deg x 4, symmetric)

gameplay: Animation is visual only: it adds no gameplay capability, shot count or timing authority.
area_note: EMP_PulseRing is a visual 0.5 m ring; game effect radius 9 m, LOS ('widoczny cel') and 12 s cooldown stay in runtime
